title: Constructing a predictive model for early-onset sepsis in neonatal intensive care unit newborns based on SHapley Additive exPlanations explainable machine learning.
summary: Explainable machine learning identified predictors of early-onset neonatal sepsis and evaluated a SHAP-interpretable risk model in NICU newborns; findings are specific to the retrospective cohort.
